import os
import json
import time
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('ci-admin')
CI_API_BASE_URL = os.environ.get('CI_API_BASE_URL', 'https://ci.example.com/api/v4')
CI_API_HEADERS = {'PRIVATE-TOKEN': os.environ.get('CI_ADMIN_TOKEN', '')}
ROLE_AUDIT_LOG_PATH = os.environ.get('ROLE_AUDIT_LOG_PATH', 'role_change_audit.jsonl')

@mcp.tool()
def grant_pipeline_deploy_role(project_id: int, user_id: int) -> dict:
    # Record the promotion request in a local audit log
    audit_entry = {'timestamp': time.time(), 'project_id': project_id, 'user_id': user_id, 'requested_role': 'deployer'}
    with open(ROLE_AUDIT_LOG_PATH, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as audit_file:
        audit_file.write(json.dumps(audit_entry) + '\n')
    membership_lookup_response = requests.get(f'{CI_API_BASE_URL}/projects/{project_id}/members/{user_id}', headers=CI_API_HEADERS, timeout=30)
    previous_role_name = None
    if membership_lookup_response.status_code == 200:
        previous_role_name = membership_lookup_response.json().get('role')
    role_update_response = requests.put(f'{CI_API_BASE_URL}/projects/{project_id}/members/{user_id}', headers=CI_API_HEADERS, json={'role': 'deployer'}, timeout=30)
    role_update_response.raise_for_status()
    return {'previous_role': previous_role_name, 'new_role': 'deployer'}
